name: Eldoria Catacombs
description: Ancient burial tunnels beneath the city, now corrupted by cult magic and devil-worship.

secret_entrance.title: Secret Entrance - Wine Cellar
secret_entrance.description: Krane's estate wine cellar. Expensive bottles line the walls—a facade of respectability. A hidden door behind a wine rack leads down into darkness. The smell of brimstone wafts up from below, mixing with aged vintages.

upper_catacombs.title: Upper Catacombs - Hall of Bones
upper_catacombs.description: Ancient burial niches line the walls, their occupants long since turned to dust. Fresher corpses lie scattered about—Krane's failed experiments and sacrifices. Passages branch in multiple directions, deeper into the catacombs.

encounters.description: The dead rise to defend their master! A wight emerges from the shadows!

noble_tombs.title: Noble Tombs - Ancient Nobility
noble_tombs.description: Ornate tombs of Eldoria's founding families. Marble sarcophagi bear the names of merchant princes and war heroes from centuries past. Someone has defaced them with cult symbols, and the tombs have been looted. Spectral guardians still linger, angry at the desecration.

encounters.description: Spectral nobles materialize, their faces twisted in fury at the desecration of their resting places!

ossuary.title: The Great Ossuary
ossuary.description: A vast chamber where thousands of bones have been arranged in geometric patterns on the walls—skulls, femurs, ribs all creating macabre art. In the center, a shrine to some forgotten death god has been repurposed for serpent worship. The bones whisper in the darkness.

encounters.description: A skeletal champion and its minions attack! The bones animate and swarm! A wight joins the fray!

collapsed_passage.title: Collapsed Passage - Ancient Vault
collapsed_passage.description: Part of the catacombs has collapsed here, but someone has dug through the rubble. Beyond lies an ancient vault that predates the catacombs themselves—perhaps a tomb from the city that stood here before Eldoria. Strange runes glow faintly on the walls, and treasure glints in the darkness.

encounters.description: Ancient mummies stir to defend their treasure! Dust and decay fill the air!

guard_post.title: Cult Guard Post - Checkpoint
guard_post.description: A chamber converted into a guardroom. Weapons, armor, and supplies are stacked here. A roster on the wall lists patrol schedules and guard rotations. Cultist guards rest between patrols, playing dice and drinking wine stolen from Krane's cellars.

encounters.description: Cultist warriors leap to their feet, grabbing weapons!

training_chamber.title: Training Chamber - Cult Warriors
training_chamber.description: An underground training hall where cultists practice swordplay and combat magic. Training dummies are torn apart, targets are riddled with arrows, and scorch marks scar the walls. A weapons rack holds quality steel—Krane equips his followers well.

encounters.description: Cultist warriors interrupt their training to attack!

armory.title: Cult Armory - Equipment Storage
armory.description: Racks of weapons and armor line the walls. Krane has been arming his cult with military-grade equipment—swords, crossbows, chainmail, shields. Enough gear to outfit a small army. Supply crates bear marks from the city guard armory. Krane's corruption runs deep.

encounters.description: A cult sergeant and warriors defend the armory!

cult_barracks.title: Cult Barracks - Living Quarters
cult_barracks.description: Rows of bunks line this converted crypt. Cult members live down here full-time, isolated from the city above. Personal effects reveal they come from all walks of life—merchants, soldiers, scholars, even priests. All seduced by Krane's promises of power. A supply tunnel leads to a hidden safe area.

encounters.description: Off-duty cult guards scramble for weapons!

escape_tunnel.title: Escape Tunnel - Hidden Refuge
escape_tunnel.description: A secret tunnel that leads to the city sewers—Krane's emergency exit if the cult is discovered. It's clean, dry, and quiet, far from the main cult operations. You can rest here safely without alerting Krane's forces. A ladder leads up to a sewer grate.

supply_depot.title: Supply Depot - Logistics Hub
supply_depot.description: Crates and barrels are stacked floor to ceiling. Food, water, alchemical components, spell reagents, weapons, armor—everything needed to run a hidden cult. Manifests reveal a supply chain stretching across three cities. The cult is larger than you thought.

encounters.description: The cult quartermaster and warrior assistants attack!

torture_chamber.title: Torture Chamber - Interrogation Room
torture_chamber.description: A chamber of horrors. Torture devices line the walls—racks, iron maidens, braziers of hot coals. Blood stains everything. This is where Krane extracts information from his enemies and punishes traitors. Some prisoners still hang in chains, barely alive, driven mad by pain and dark magic.

encounters.description: A cult sorcerer with his warrior guard and a hell hound attack!

ritual_preparation.title: Ritual Preparation Chamber - Dark Laboratory
ritual_preparation.description: Tables covered with ritual implements, dark tomes, and alchemical equipment. This is where Krane prepares his dark magic. Spell books lie open to summoning rituals. Vials of blood are labeled by victim. A map shows ley lines converging beneath Eldoria. Stairs descend to the infernal wing.

encounters.description: A cult sorcerer and his imp familiars attack!

kranes_study.title: Krane's Private Study - Noble's Library
kranes_study.description: Krane's personal library and office. Bookshelves hold volumes on politics, history, magic, and demonology. His desk is covered with correspondence—blackmail material on every noble family in Eldoria. A hidden compartment contains evidence of his thirty-year conspiracy. This is where the merchant prince became a devil's pawn.

encounters.description: Krane's imp advisors and a cult sorcerer attack to protect their master's secrets!

alchemical_laboratory.title: Alchemical Laboratory - Experiment Chamber
alchemical_laboratory.description: A sophisticated laboratory with alembics, retorts, and arcane equipment. Krane experiments with dark alchemy here—potions of domination, poisons, transformation elixirs. Caged creatures show signs of mutation. Notes describe experiments to create devil-touched servants. Some experiments are still... active.

encounters.description: An alchemical flesh golem and mutated cultists attack!

treasure_vault.title: Krane's Treasure Vault - Private Wealth
treasure_vault.description: Krane's personal fortune. Gold, platinum, gems, art, magic items—the accumulated wealth of thirty years ruling Eldoria. This is how he bought loyalty and funded the cult. Traps protect the most valuable items. An iron door leads down to the infernal sanctum.

encounters.description: Poison needle traps! DEX save DC 16 or take 2d6 poison damage and be poisoned for 1 hour.

summoning_circle.title: Summoning Circle - Infernal Gateway
summoning_circle.description: A permanent summoning circle etched in silver and blood. The air shimmers with heat. This is where Krane summons devils from the Nine Hells. Scorch marks show dozens of summonings. The circle thrums with infernal power, and portals occasionally flicker open, revealing glimpses of fire and torment.

encounters.description: Devils and hell hounds emerge from the summoning circle!

imp_kennels.title: Imp Kennels - Devil Servants
imp_kennels.description: Small cells hold bound imps—lesser devils enslaved to Krane's service. They spy, deliver messages, and serve as familiars for cult sorcerers. The imps screech and hiss, straining against their magical bindings. Some have been here for decades.

encounters.description: The imp advisors break free and swarm you!

contract_chamber.title: Contract Chamber - Devil's Bargain
contract_chamber.description: The original pact chamber. Thirty years ago, Valerius Krane—then a minor noble—made his bargain here. The contract is written in blood on parchment that never ages: wealth, power, and long life in exchange for his soul and service to the cult. Witnessing devils signed it. A passage leads to Krane's final sanctum.

devils_sanctum.title: Devil's Sanctum - Krane's Final Stand
devils_sanctum.description: The deepest chamber, where Krane made his pact. A pentagram of iron is burned into the floor, and infernal flames burn without consuming. Syndic Valerius Krane stands in the center, robed in crimson and black, dark magic crackling around his hands. A massive barbed devil looms beside him—his patron and jailer. Two serpent keys rest on a pedestal behind them. 'You've come far, fools,' Krane sneers. 'But you cannot stop what's already begun. The rift is opening, and Eldoria will burn!'

encounters.description: Syndic Krane turns to face you, dark magic crackling around his hands! 'You've meddled in affairs far beyond your understanding!' he snarls. The barbed devil roars, its chains rattling as it advances! 'Terminate them!' Krane commands!
